purpose: Define a layered, rarity-aware hero progression model before replacing displayed account stats with reconstructed native hero stats.

nativeDataDiscovery.note: The embedded DataTable version and the public hot-update descriptor are separate version layers. Do not equate 38781 with hot-update descriptor 1295.

hardRules: Do not use displayed account ATK/DEF/HP as native hero inputs because they can already include account-wide buffs.
Never assume UR, SSR and SR use the same level-growth curve until cross-rarity validation succeeds.
Never treat an SSR-to-UR promotion as a cosmetic rarity change. SSR and UR states are distinct combat/stat variants.
Do not derive total hero power from one table. Power is composed from native level stats plus stars/grade, skills, exclusive weapon, awakening/promotion and other modeled layers.
Unknown coefficients remain pending; no silent fallback from one rarity or variant to another.
Join native hero configuration by numeric nativeId, never by localized display name.

nativeLevelModelResearch.candidateShape: stat(hero, rarity, level) = base(hero, rarity, stat) + growth(hero, rarity, stat) * F_rarity(level), with exact rounding/piecewise rules still to be recovered from DataTable schemas
nativeLevelModelResearch.validationRequirement: A curve becomes verified only if the recovered native table fields and one F_rarity(level) reproduce ATK, DEF and HP for multiple heroes at multiple levels within observed client rounding.

knownAnchor.derivedRelation: The three observed Grade bonuses are consistent with +28% of the pre-Grade native level-150 stat layer after rounding.

requiredNext: Recover every 1/5-star sub-tier multiplier from 0-star through 5-star.
Validate whether UR, SSR and SR use identical star multipliers or rarity-specific multipliers.
Separate stat multipliers from star-unlocked skill effects.

rules: Track star breakpoints separately from medal-level scaling.
Expertise/Super Sensing stat percentages are a skill layer and must not be baked into native level stats.
Promoted SSR-to-UR heroes may receive a different skill kit and reset skill levels.
